name: health-evidence-companion
description: General adult health explanations, medicine information and evidence navigation with current primary sources.

interface.longDescription: Understand adult health questions, allergies and allergy tests, laboratory concepts, vaccine calendars, medicine labels, mechanisms, interaction evidence and psychiatric medicine information. Assess treatment claims, homeopathy and research using indication-specific evidence checks and primary sources in Serbia, Russia and internationally. Learn to design a separate private archive with blank templates. Answers follow your language. This skills-only package has no required local server or paid medical API. It provides general information and clinician questions, not definitive diagnoses, prescriptions, treatment changes or personal record management. It does not solicit or process PHI. Source reading limits, dated calendar scope and pending medicine appraisals are explicit; current guidance must be checked when relevant.
defaultPrompt: Explain what doctors consider when an adult cough persists.
How do SSRIs and NSAIDs interact?
What does research say about zinc for colds?

publication.release_notes: Version 0.2.1 adds permanent GitHub release downloads and browser setup instructions, updates the contribution release process, selects Healthcare to reflect the package purpose and clarifies data handling, recipients, retention and user controls in the privacy policy. Six skills and 128 registered sources remain included. General information only; no patient-record processing or required paid API. Platform findings must be checked again after upload; this version does not imply approval.
